customer_reply:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out with urgency. With 308 new team members blocked from authenticating into CloudSync via Salesforce SSO, we have escalated this ticket to our Security and Identity Engineering team with P1 priority.

The DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE error typically indicates either a certificate mismatch or an unmapped user attribute profile on the Salesforce IDP SAML assertion for new user provisioning.

Our security engineers are checking the SAML trace logs immediately and will provide an update shortly.

Best regards,
Identity & Security Team
